common.title: Arktik — custom software, built in the open
common.description: A software studio in Indonesia. Leave the building to us — the price agreed before each stage, and everything in your name.

header.banner: You talk to the engineers, not an account manager

hero.description: Leave the building to us, so you can run the business instead of the project. The price is agreed before each stage starts, working software arrives every week, and the code and every account are in your name from day one.

aboutUs.quoteText: 95% of new products miss the mark — not because of the idea, but because of poor execution
aboutUs.quoteSource: MIT Professional Programs: Why 95% of New Products Miss the Mark
aboutUs.mainDescription: Software rarely fails on the idea. It fails on execution. Execution is a process problem, and process is the part we are strict about.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.description1: A small studio in Indonesia building custom software for businesses that have outgrown their spreadsheets and off-the-shelf tools.
whoWeAre.description2: We keep the team small deliberately. It is the only way the person who planned your project is still the person building it three months later.

howWeWork.title: How we think
howWeWork.description1: Openly, and in writing. The reasoning behind a decision is worth more a year later than the decision itself.
howWeWork.description2: We would rather tell you something is a bad idea early than build it politely and watch it fail.
howWeWork.description3: Agreeing each stage up front means you can stop after any of them without an argument.

collaboration.title: Proven technology
collaboration.description: Widely used, well-supported tools. The interesting part should be your product, not the technology we picked.

expertise.title: Reasons written down
expertise.description: If we cannot explain why we did something, we have not finished the work.

impact.title: Small and senior
impact.description: No layer between you and the person writing the code.

innovation.title: Honest estimates
innovation.description: We quote what the work costs, not what wins the deal.

customDevelopment.title: Web and mobile applications
customDevelopment.description: Things people use every day — customer portals, booking systems, internal systems, online shops. Built on proven, widely used technology, so the next person to work on it can pick it up quickly.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: A review, a second opinion, or a plan. Useful when you already have a team and need to know whether what you have will hold up, or what to build next.

aiAutomation.title: Automation and AI
aiAutomation.description: Taking the manual work out — handling documents, sorting requests, summarising, internal assistants. If a spreadsheet would do the job, we will say so.

design.title: Product design
design.description: How it looks and how it flows, for things that actually get built. Delivered as real working screens, not a PDF.

operations.title: Running it after launch
operations.description: Hosting, monitoring, fixes, and the small changes that come up once real people are using it. For teams who would rather not take that on. Priced monthly, cancel whenever, and the accounts stay in your name throughout.

mainCard.title: Small on purpose.
mainCard.description: You get the people who did the pitch. Nobody is swapped out after signing and nothing is subcontracted — so it is one conversation, not a chain of them.

globalExperience.title: Seven years inside product teams
globalExperience.description: Before this studio we spent seven years building and shipping product at established technology companies. That is where the process on this page comes from.

endToEnd.title: We stay if you want us to
endToEnd.description: Plenty of clients would rather not run it themselves, and we are happy to — hosting, support, and whatever comes next, agreed the same way as everything else. The difference is that you are choosing it, not stuck with it.

tailored.title: We say no
tailored.description: If an off-the-shelf tool solves your problem, we will tell you and point you at it. Custom software is expensive and it should be the right call.

proven.title: Built to be handed to someone else
proven.description: Proven tools, conventional structure, and the reasoning recorded alongside the code. Whether the next person is your team, another studio, or us in a year, nothing depends on what is only in someone's head.

contact.title: Tell us what you're building.
contact.description: A few sentences is enough to start. The first step is a call to work out what you need — no charge, no sales deck — and you can stop there with the plan in hand.

process.title: How we work
process.description: Four stages, each agreed before it starts — so the only thing you ever have to decide is whether to keep going.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: We work out the real problem, who uses it, and what limits us — before anyone writes code. You end up with a written plan and a fixed price, and it is yours to keep whether you continue with us or not.

design.title: Design
design.description: We decide how it looks and how it is built, together. You review real screens in your browser, not slides.

build.title: Build
build.description: Delivered in pieces you can actually use. A working demo every week, and a private link you can open any time — you don’t have to watch it being built, you just always can.

handover.title: Handover
handover.description: The code, the documentation, and every password and account are confirmed as yours. From here some clients run it themselves and others keep us on to do it. You are choosing which, and that is the whole point of doing the first three stages this way.

scope.title: Agreed before we start
scope.description: What you get and what it costs are put in writing before each stage begins. No renegotiating halfway through.

ownership.title: Everything ends up yours
ownership.description: The code, the servers, the domain, and every account are in your name from the first day — not ours.

access.title: Talk to the people building it
access.description: You deal directly with the people writing the software. Nobody relays messages on our behalf.

products.title: Our products
products.subtitle: Besides client work, we build and run products of our own. Same process, except the client is us.

faq.q: How much does an app cost?
faq.a: It depends on the scope. The first consultation is free. After that, discovery produces a written plan and a fixed price for the next stage. The plan is yours to keep, whether you continue with us or not.
Discovery 1–2 weeks, design 2–3 weeks, build from 6 weeks, and handover 1 week. The first version is deliberately small so it is in use quickly.
If an existing app solves your problem, we will say so and show you which one. Custom software is expensive, so it has to be the right call.

faq.q: What if we want to change vendors later?
faq.a: You can. The code, servers, domain, and accounts are in your name, and the technology is widely used, so another team can pick it up quickly.

websites.title: A website that gets visitors to contact you
intro: Plenty of business websites look good and stay quiet: visitors arrive, look around, and leave without getting in touch. Usually the thing they came for, such as a price, an example of the work, or how to order, is missing or hidden.
We build websites with one clear goal per page: a consultation, a quote request, or a booking. Visitors find the answer on the first screen, and one button takes them to the form or WhatsApp.

built.title: Company and service websites
built.description: A clear portfolio and services, with the same call to action on every page.

built.title: Landing pages
built.description: One page for one goal: a consultation, a quote, or a reservation.

built.title: Catalogues with prices
built.description: Starting prices and estimates, so visitors know the range before they ask.

built.title: Forms into WhatsApp
built.description: Forms and buttons that open WhatsApp with the message already filled in.

built.title: Multilingual websites
built.description: Indonesian, English, or any other language your customers use, each on its own URL so every version can be found on Google.

built.title: SEO foundations done right
built.description: Per-page titles and descriptions, a sitemap, and structured data from the start.

websites.examplesNote: Websites we have built, including one design concept.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It depends on the number of pages, languages, and features such as a catalogue or forms. The first consultation is free: we map out what you need, then the price is agreed in writing before work starts.

faq.q: Whose name are the domain and hosting in?
faq.a: Yours, from day one. Not ours.

faq.q: Can we start with a single page?
faq.a: Yes, and we often recommend it. One landing page that works beats ten pages nobody reads.
We agree it up front: you edit it yourself, or we make the changes as part of the monthly service after launch.

websites.ctaDescription: Send us the address and tell us who you want to reach. The first call is free.

automation.name: Automation & AI
automation.metaTitle: Business Automation & AI for SMEs | Arktik
automation.metaDescription: Take out repetitive manual work: document handling, request sorting, summaries, internal assistants. If a spreadsheet would do, we will say so.
automation.summary: Document handling, request sorting, summaries, and internal assistants.
automation.title: Free your team from work a machine can do
intro: Copying data from email into a system, reading documents one by one, answering the same question every day. Work like this eats the hours of people who should be doing something else.

We build automation and AI where the bottleneck actually is. Start with one process, measure the result, then move to the next. If a spreadsheet or a tool you already have would solve it, we will say so.

built.title: Document handling
built.description: Reading invoices, forms, or PDFs and entering the data into your system.

built.title: Sorting incoming requests
built.description: Messages from email, forms, or WhatsApp sorted and passed to the right person.

built.title: Automatic summaries
built.description: Daily reports, conversation recaps, and summaries of long documents.

built.title: Internal assistants
built.description: Answering your team's questions from your own company documents.

built.title: System integrations
built.description: So nobody retypes data from one app into another.

automation.examplesNote: Jejak Saham turns public disclosure documents into searchable data every day.

faq.a: Before anything is built, we map out together what data is processed, where it is stored, and who can access it. Every service account is in your name.

faq.q: What if the AI gets it wrong?
faq.a: We decide together which steps need a person to check the result before it is used.
With the one process that takes the most time. Discovery produces an estimate of the cost to build and run it, set against the working hours it saves.

automation.ctaTitle: Which work would you most like gone?
automation.ctaDescription: Tell us about one repetitive process. We will help you judge whether it is worth automating, and the first call is free.

consulting.name: Technical consulting
consulting.metaDescription: A second opinion on a system you run or plan to build: code, architecture, and plan reviews. Talk directly to engineers.
consulting.summary: Code and architecture reviews, vendor quotes, and planning before you build.
consulting.title: A second opinion before an expensive decision
intro: A vendor quote feels too high, or too low. The system you run keeps getting slower and harder to change. Your team wants to build something new but isn't sure how. At moments like these, one independent opinion can save far more than it costs.
We review what you have or what you are planning, then give you a written recommendation you can use, with or without us.

built.title: Code and architecture reviews
built.description: For apps already running: what will hold up, and what to fix first.

built.title: Vendor quote reviews
built.description: Reading proposals and prices from other vendors before you sign.

built.title: Planning before you build
built.description: The scope of the first version and the technology choices.

built.title: Ownership audits
built.description: Making sure the code, servers, domain, and accounts really are in your name.

faq.a: The first call is free, to understand what you are weighing up. If you need an in-depth review and a written recommendation, the scope and price are agreed before it starts.

faq.q: What if the recommendation is another vendor or an in-house team?
faq.a: That's fine. The recommendation is yours, and we will tell you if we are not the right fit.
The same engineers who build software at Arktik, not an account manager.
